title: Readiness Is Not Evidence: Fail-Closed Epistemic Boundaries for Governed AI Services
description:
PREPRINT - NOT PEER REVIEWED. This work presents fail-closed boundaries that keep service readiness, query support, proof admission, numerical comparison, telemetry delivery, execution authorization, and deployment as orthogonal evidence dimensions.

The frozen manuscript is 24 pages. The manuscript and documentation are licensed CC BY 4.0. Bundled software and code snapshots retain their Apache-2.0 notices.
